info.description: 製品・ライセンス管理、プロダクトキー発行V1/V8、端末認証、MNSL、HA管理の公開API仕様です。V2〜V7の新規発行は終了しました。既存のV4〜V6ジョブは照会・結果取得・取消のみ利用できます。

post.summary: Issue a one-time card challenge or verify a local MNSL CSP signature
post.description: Admin reception flow for a Windows localhost bridge using the MNSL JPKI authentication CSP. The server verifies an RSA signature over a fresh tenant-scoped challenge, stores only a tenant-specific HMAC public-key fingerprint, and does not receive a PIN, private key, or certificate. The API does not validate the certificate issuer, chain, or revocation state and does not assert legal identity verification.

flow_id.description: Required for verify; opaque one-time flow ID.

signature.description: Base64url RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 signature.

200.description: The one-time card-key signature was verified

201.description: A challenge was issued; expires in 180 seconds

403.description: Admin reception session or tenant:read authorization required

503.description: HA node is not writable

post.summary: Create or report a short-lived Android NFC card-read session
post.description: The admin reception page creates and polls a tenant-scoped, one-time QR session using X-HA-Session and tenant:read. The installed Android app opens the verified App Link and may report only read completion or failure using the one-time flow_id and nonce. The nonce is carried in the URL fragment and is not sent in the fallback HTTP request. No card attributes, photo, PIN, certificate, or cryptographic card proof are submitted. A completion report is not JPKI or legal identity verification.

parameters.name: X-HA-Session
parameters.description: Required with X-Tenant-ID and X-BaaS-Environment for create/status; app actions use the one-time flow_id and nonce.

flow_id.description: Opaque one-time flow ID from the QR link.

nonce.description: Required for app_status/complete/fail; one-time nonce in the QR URL fragment.

200.description: Session state or app-reported read outcome

201.description: Tenant-scoped Android read QR session created; expires in 180 seconds

403.description: Admin reception session or tenant:read authorization required for create/status

409.description: QR session expired, already used, or terminal

503.description: HA node is not writable
